claims.claim: Transmissions Gearbox M278 1282 OEM G63, Mercedes transmission gearbox.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show an automatic transmission/gearbox assembly but do not provide a readable make/model/part number, so M278/1282/G63/OEM cannot be confirmed.
Photos show heavy grime/scuffs and internal wear marks, but no functional test results (no video/scan/bench test) are shown.
No test documentation, diagnostic printout, or running/bench test video is shown in the witness report.
No odometer/usage record or readable identifier is shown in the photos.
Photos do not show tamper evidence clearly (e.g., opened casing bolts/seal marks) and cannot confirm assembly history.
No shipping/import documents or labels readable enough to confirm origin are shown.

risks.risk: Wrong fit/compatibility risk (part number/variant mismatch for the claimed vehicle/engine).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission ID/part number label and/or stamped code on the casing (and the vehicle compatibility details: make/model/year/engine/drivetrain).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used automatic gearbox with unknown compatibility (worst-case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Unknown internal condition despite appearance (clutch packs/torque converter/pump wear not verifiable from photos).
risks.proof: A short video of a bench test or a diagnostic scan showing live shift/solenoid operation and fault codes (or a reputable test report).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: may require overhaul).

risks.risk: Missing components/sensors/solenoids/valve body parts or incomplete kit.
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo showing all external sensors/connectors/solenoids/valve body components and mounting hardware included (and close-ups of connector ports).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: missing parts).

risks.risk: Leak/seal failure risk (gaskets/seals may be compromised; oil seepage not confirmed).
risks.proof: Photos showing the underside/casing for wetness, plus a clip of the unit after cleaning (or proof of oil level/pressure test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially leaking (worst-case: seals/gaskets may need replacement).

risks.risk: Damage from removal/handling (surface damage may correlate with deeper issues).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all mounting points, bell housing edges, and any cracks/dents, plus a straight-on inspection of the casing for structural damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible handling damage (worst-case: may affect installation or internal integrity).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the transmission ID/part number label and any stamped codes on the casing (must be readable).
Send the exact vehicle compatibility: vehicle make/model/year, engine type, drivetrain (RWD/AWD), and whether it’s for G63 as claimed.
Provide proof of testing: a short video of the transmission being tested (bench or vehicle) and/or a diagnostic scan report showing no active faults.
Show a complete parts checklist: photos of all sensors/solenoids/valve body external parts and connectors included, plus mounting bolts/hardware if present.
Provide leak/seal evidence: photos of the unit after wiping/cleaning and a clip showing no seepage, or an oil pressure/condition test result.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a used automatic transmission/gearbox assembly, but the key details needed to price it safely (exact part number/fit, completeness, and verified working condition) are not readable or shown. Without proof, the worst-case pricing depends on missing identifiers and test evidence.
